title: Total influence of the majority head coalition
statement: Let $k,m:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and $t\in\mathbb{R}$. If $m(q)\to\infty$ and $k(q)/\sqrt{m(q)}\to t$, then the probability that the first $k(q)$ coordinates can make majority attain both possible outputs, for a uniformly random input on $k(q)+m(q)$ coordinates, converges to $2\bigl(\tfrac12-Q(t)\bigr)$, where $Q(t)=\Pr(Z>t)$ for a standard normal random variable $Z$.
